latestVersion.changelog:
Version 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Launches "Editor Free Download" for fast, online video editing with no software downloads needed.
- Lets users upload raw video files and describe desired edits in plain text to generate 1080p MP4 exports.
- Automatic setup includes easy token generation (100 free credits/7 days) and backend connection.
- Supports various file types (video, audio, image); cloud GPU rendering processes edits server-side.
- Provides clear feedback on status, credits, and errors; easy-to-follow workflows and tips included.
